# Northwind Shipping Policy

Northwind fulfills B2B orders from regional warehouses.

## Service Levels

### Express SLA

Express orders ship within 24 hours of payment confirmation on business days.

### Standard SLA

Standard orders ship within 5 business days of payment confirmation.

## Shipping Zones

### Domestic Zones

Domestic zones cover the contiguous United States and are billed by weight tier.

### International Zones

International zones require a commercial invoice and may add 2 business days for customs prep.
